earnings.title: Okta Announces Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
highlights: Q2 revenue grew 11% and subscription revenue grew 12% year-over-year
Revenue: Total revenue was $805 million , an increase of 11% year-over-year.
Subscription revenue was $793 million, an increase of 12% year-over-year.

GAAP Operating Income: GAAP operating income was $107 million , or 13% of total revenue, compared to GAAP operating income of $41 million , or 6% of total revenue, in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
Operating cash flow of $234 million and free cash flow of $227 million

quotes.text: As AI agents transform every layer of technology, every agent needs a trusted identity and clear controls over what it can access and do.
quotes.by: Todd McKinnon, Chief Executive Officer and co-founder of Okta

quotes.text: Our Q2 performance was highlighted by accelerating cRPO, success with our largest customers, and strong profitability and cash flow.
quotes.by: Brett Tighe, Chief Financial Officer of Okta

outlook: Total revenue of $813 million to $817 million, representing a growth rate of 10% year-over-year;
Current RPO of $2.590 billion to $2.600 billion , representing a growth rate of 11% to 12% year-over-year;
Non-GAAP operating income of $196 million to $200 million, which yields a non-GAAP operating margin of 24% to 25%;
Non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $0.92 to $0.94, assuming diluted weighted-average shares outstanding of approximately 184 million and a non-GAAP tax rate of 21%; and

items.heading: Adverse general economic, market and industry conditions and reductions in workforce identity and customer identity spending have, in the past and may, in the future, reduce demand for our solutions, which could harm our revenue, results of operations and cash flows.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: Our business depends on our ability to retain existing customers, and our revenues and results of operations could be adversely impacted if they do not renew their subscriptions or purchase additional licenses or subscriptions with us.

items.heading: If we are unable to grow our customer base, our revenue growth and profitability could be harmed.

items.heading: We face intense competition, especially from larger, well-established companies, and we may lack sufficient financial or other resources to maintain or improve our competitive position.

items.heading: If we fail to adapt to rapid technological change, our ability to remain competitive could be impaired.
